text:
elaine: Pushing a tiny design ask — banner that appears after first session (post-signup) to nudge users to either continue the guided tour or jump into a sample project. Screenshot attached: https://img.redwood.in/first-session-banner.png sam: I like the idea but worried about noise. Is this ephemeral for the first session only? elaine: yes, show once per workspace by default; option to ‘Don’t show again’ in the banner. We want high clarity ctas: primary = Continue tour, secondary = Pick a sample. matt: Copy tweak: “Continue tour” feels passive. What about “Finish set-up” vs “Explore sample projects”? Also accessibility: contrast on the secondary CTA is low on the screenshot. priya: +1 on copy. Also keyboard flow: if a screen reader user tabs into the page after signup, does the banner get focus? We should avoid focus traps but ensure keyboard users can reach it. Suggest aria-live="polite" and an initial focusable element with aria-describedby summarizing options. jordana: For contrast numbers: currently button text ratio is 3.2:1 — fails AA small text. We should hit 4.5:1 for body text or use a bolder weight and darker bg. sam: Can we make the primary (tour) a solid color and secondary an outline with stronger text color? That usually fixes contrast while keeping hierarchy. elaine: Good. Also discussion about visual affordance: should the banner be centered overlay or anchored top rail? UX research lean suggests anchored rail is less disruptive for power users. New signups liked a subtle rail. matt: Anchored rail means it competes with top nav for attention. If anchored, ensure it collapses automatically after CTA or after user scrolls away. Accessibility: add a dismiss button with aria-label="Dismiss first session banner". priya: Agree on dismiss button. Also add an invisible skip link at top for screen readers: `Skip onboarding banner` so keyboard users can bypass. jordana: Measurement: we'll instrument two events: `onboard_banner_shown`, `onboard_banner_action` with a property `action: tour|sample|dismiss`. A/B test rail vs overlay for 2 weeks. sam: Small copy options to test: A) "Finish setup — 3 steps" vs B) "Continue tour". Prefer A for clarity. elaine: Decision for this iteration: anchored top rail, primary CTA copy = "Finish setup — 3 steps", secondary = "Try a sample project", add "Don't show again" checkbox, stronger outline color for secondary to meet 4.5:1, dismiss button + sr skip link, aria-live polite. Priya, can you draft the aria attributes? Jordana, can you add the telemetry events to the spec? priya: On it. I'll post a small snippet for devs:```

Finish setup — 3 steps

``` jordana: I'll add `onboard_banner_shown` at impression time and `onboard_banner_action` on click with `action` property. Also add `banner_variant: rail|overlay` for the experiment. deploy-bot: Reminder: feature flag `first_session_banner_v1` will gate rollout. matt: One last thing — keyboard focus order: ensure dismiss is last in tab order and that hitting ESC dismisses the banner and sends `onboard_banner_action` with action=dismiss. elaine: Perfect. I'll update the Figma with the contrast fix and post a new screenshot. Thanks all :heart: Next step: Priya & Jordana to post PR-ready aria/telemetry snippets by EOD tomorrow.
